extraction_notes: Multi-variant datasheet covering ES5ABF through ES5JBF (Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd, www.ichjc.com); ES5JBF column values used: VRRM=600V, VRMS=420V, VDC=600V, VF max=1.7V (page 1-2).

Key maximum ratings (page 1): IF(AV)=5.0A at 60Hz sinewave resistance load, IFSM=150A at t=8.3ms half-sine, Tstg=-55 to +150degC, Tj=-55 to +150degC, RthJA=78degC/W, RthJL=45degC/W. Package SMBF, cathode line denotes cathode end, glass passivated junction.
Second reverse leakage spec not representable in the single reverse_current slot: IR=200uA maximum at VR=VDC, Ta=125degC (page 2).

Fig.3 shows three curves (ES5ABF-ES5DBF solid, ES5EBF-ES5GBF long dash, ES5JBF dotted); only the ES5JBF dotted curve was digitized. Digitized typical VF at 5A is 1.48V vs the 1.7V table maximum, consistent.

Curves digitized from a 200 dpi rasterization of page 2 with pixel-level axis calibration against detected gridlines (Fig.3 y-log calibration cross-checked against minor decade lines). Reading uncertainty approximately +/-0.01V on Fig.3 voltages, +/-2A on Fig.2 currents, +/-5% on Fig.4 log-axis currents, +/-0.1A on Fig.1.
Fig.3 ES5JBF curve points below 0.05A were not digitized because the legend text overlaps those rows; the curve visually starts near 1.05V at about 0.012A.
Fig.2 points at 20 and 100 cycles fell on gridline overlaps and were omitted from sampling; the plotted curve reaches approximately 60A at 20 cycles and 34A at 100 cycles.

Fig.4 reverse-current curves are family-wide percent-of-rated-VRRM curves; to convert to absolute volts for ES5JBF multiply x-values by 6 (100% = 600V). Both curves show a sharp typical avalanche knee near 123-127% of rated VRRM (about 740-760V for ES5JBF); this is a typical normalized curve, not a guaranteed spec, so breakdown_voltage and breakdown_current are null.
Fig.1 derating: flat at 5.0A up to about 100degC lead temperature, then approximately linear at -0.1A/degC reaching zero near 151degC.
